adaptations: Original Rust item conversion, browse queries, home rows and stream negotiation reused.
Tauri config and connector registry replaced by cancellable per-request native JSON adapter; profile credentials live in iOS Keychain.
Native device ID assigned per signed-in account; no desktop path identity or global private credential cache.
API body capped at 8 MiB; API redirects restricted to original origin; authorization fields validated before IO.
No raw password persisted; token-bearing playback URL stays in ephemeral resolution, outside remembered track metadata.
Server start/stop notifications are ordered from real player lifecycle events, after load rather than during stream resolution.
